item.title: 2024 Q3 Summary
item.description:
This is a summary for July 2024 to September 2024.

This quarter passed quite quickly; it doesn’t seem long since the last review. There truly is a gap in intelligence between people; I feel like I’m a not-very-hardworking fool.
